Our Belief
For a project to have lasting impact, three elements must be respected — concept, culture and craft.

All three link to human-centred design and long-term value creation in the built environment — essential to the flourishing of cities and communities. We work across West Africa and in collaboration with international partners, carrying a project from first sketch through to handover.

Approach

Three marks on every site plan.

Mark A 01

Concept

Every brief is read against its site before it is read against a program — testing ideas until they settle into a response that is pragmatic, sustainable and true to place.

Mark B 02

Culture

Materiality, climate and community are not constraints to design around, but the starting material itself — the difference between a building that sits on a site and one that belongs to it.

Mark C 03

Craft

Feasibility, construction and delivery are held under one roof, so the drawing and the built wall are answerable to the same standard, start to finish.
